# book_tag_object (Resource)

The tag_object records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `object_id` (String) Object the tag is attached to.
- `object_type` (String) Type of the object the tag is attached to.

### Optional

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `location_id` (String) The key of the location record.
- `tag_id` (String) The key of the tag record.
